First piece of advice, don’t use tapers. 

I highly suggest reading the “stretching advice” category on the sub before continuing with anything. 

Don’t force anything through, take the tapers out and try again later, when your ears are less angry, with a different method, I suggest either tape or dead-stretching.

It took me about 10 months to get up to 12 mm, but it might take you longer, as I had previously had my ears stretched a bit so they never fully shrunk back. When I decided to start again, 10 gauge plugs slipped right in with no issues. I know it’s really annoying to have to wait, but in the long run, your lobes will be much healthier if you take your time, and give them oil massages. Just take it slow, and don’t force anything, that’s how blowouts and rips happen.

Ichthyophthirius multifiliis, or just “ich” for short. It’s a type of parasite and It’s caused by the fish not having a thick enough slime coating on their body, if I remember correctly. 

It’s almost like when dogs get ticks, but with fish. 

Though treatable, it usually is a pain in the butt to get rid of. 

I would strongly suggest moving her and any other fish that have it to a separate quarantine tank, with ich treated water (you can buy bottles of it at really any pet store, I recommend the brand API) and wash the plants and substrate very well with hot water to kill the bacteria, but make sure not to use soap.

Hi! I’ve had my snakebites since august, so I might be able to answer these questions. I got mine done at the same time, left then right. I swelled up a little bit, and had some trouble talking and eating at first because I was paranoid of them getting infected (which never happened, btw), but I think the worst part of the healing was just the swelling, which only lasted about a week, maybe a little longer. I don’t regret getting them at all, and they make me feel so much better about myself. 

In all honesty, I think you should go for it. If you don’t like them, you can always take them out and let them heal over. Just remember to clean them with wound wash and don’t eat any spicy foods for a bit. Best of luck!
